# QuadWild-BiMDF notice

PrePoMax distributes the supplied Windows binaries for QuadWild-BiMDF version
0.0.2 as separate processes:

- quadwild.exe
- quad_from_patches.exe

The package also includes the unmodified runtime configuration tree. Its included
README_release.md identifies the binary version as 0.0.2.
